name_full: Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support

metadata.description: Twelve-item measure of perceived support from family, friends, and a significant other.
metadata.intended_use: Research and social-support assessment; the German evidence in this record includes older-adult psychometrics.
metadata.name_origin: Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support, abbreviated MSPSS.
metadata.development_history: Originally introduced by Zimet and colleagues in 1988; German population evidence must be kept version-specific.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Three support-source dimensions distinguish perceived availability of different social relationships.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Perceived support is not identical to network size or objectively received support; use German validation evidence for the target population.
